The New Project form is now two columns. Template and Agents are in the right-hand column, and everything else stays on the left. All tests pass (172, 1 ignored); I haven't looked at the form in the running app.

- **Left column:** Name, Location, the Git checkbox, then Spec root, Code root and Shape root.

The columns are equal width, top-aligned, and scroll together when the panel is too short. The old 640px width cap on the form is gone, since two columns need the room.

The New Project test now checks that the right column sits beside the left one, starting at the same height. It also checks both groups are inside that column, with Agents below Template. The existing check that no agent checkbox gets cut off in a short window still passes.

The spec in `spec/scope/new-project/index.pi` has a new `layout` section, and its template and agents sections say they're in the second column. `piton check`, `piton build check` and `piton build` ran cleanly, and the app builds with no warnings.
